browser_fixture_notes: The native fictional XLSX contains 4997 extracted rows. Exact indices 4999/5000 use a controlled source sidecar because the unchanged native extractor limits all extracted source lines, including worksheet headings, to 5000.
Missing or ambiguous coordinates, invalid applied records and ownership cases use controlled metadata/session fixtures.
Repeated header rows remain in mapped TSV. Existing item choices explicitly exclude nonphysical rows before Check/save; the header advisory performs no automatic exclusion.
Genuine lost-response retry preserved the identical draft, token and operation ID and saved two selected fictional records exactly once.

No live mail, physical device, Windows desktop or production acceptance.
